gaps.lead: Somebody is repairing our roof at the moment.
gaps.explanation: Somebody else is doing it for us: we are having our roof repaired.

gaps.lead: If you don't hurry, you'll miss the bus.
It was unfair of the referee to send him off.
gaps.explanation: should(n't) have + participle criticises a past decision.

gaps.lead: If I were in charge, overtime would be paid automatically.
gaps.explanation: Dropping 'if' inverts the subjunctive: Were I in charge…

gaps.lead: It would be sensible to leave before the traffic builds up.
gaps.sentence: We ___ before the traffic builds up.
gaps.explanation: 'It would be sensible to do' = 'we had better do' — had better + bare infinitive.

gaps.lead: The number of students is rising.
gaps.sentence: There is ___ the number of students.
gaps.explanation: 'Is rising' becomes the noun: 'an increase in'.
